decisions.quote: While it has been shown to support natural language code search and code documentation generation tasks, its effectiveness for code clone detection is not explored in depth. In this paper, we aim to replicate and evaluate the performance of CodeBERT for code clone detection on multiple datasets with varying functionalities to understand (1) whether CodeBERT can generalize to unseen code, (2) how fine-tuning can effect CodeBERT’s performance on unseen code, and (3) how CodeBERT performs for detecting various code clone types.
